<?php
class QuietCompositeRead {
    private int $value = 41;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return $incoming !== "skip"; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): ?int { echo "G;"; if ($incoming === "zero") { return "0"; } return null; }
    public function __set(string $incoming, $value): void { global $written; echo "S;"; $written = $value; }
}
function quietCompositeRhs(): int { echo "RHS;"; return 9; }
$written = 42;
$receiver = new QuietCompositeRead;
$selector = "zero";
echo empty($receiver->$selector) ? "EMPTY_ZERO;" : "BAD_EMPTY;";
echo ($receiver->$selector ?? quietCompositeRhs()) === 0 ? "INT_ZERO;" : "BAD_ZERO;";
$selector = "none";
echo ($receiver->$selector ?? quietCompositeRhs()) === 9 ? "NULL_FALL;" : "BAD_FALL;";
echo ($receiver->value ??= quietCompositeRhs()) === 9 ? "ASSIGN;" : "BAD_ASSIGN;";
echo $written === 9 ? "SET;" : "BAD_SET;";
echo ($receiver->skip ?? quietCompositeRhs()) === 9 ? "SKIP;" : "BAD_SKIP;";
echo $selector === "none" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class QuietThreeRead {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): int|string|null { echo "G;"; if ($incoming === "string") { return "0"; } if ($incoming === "int") { return 0; } return null; }
}
function quietThreeRhs(): int { echo "RHS;"; return 9; }
$receiver = new QuietThreeRead;
$selector = "string";
echo ($receiver->$selector ?? quietThreeRhs()) === "0" ? "STRING;" : "BAD_STRING;";
$selector = "int";
echo ($receiver->$selector ?? quietThreeRhs()) === 0 ? "INT;" : "BAD_INT;";
$selector = "none";
echo ($receiver->$selector ?? quietThreeRhs()) === 9 ? "NULL_FALL;" : "BAD_NULL;";
echo $selector === "none" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";
